# ADR-0104: the figure sheet is carried byte for byte

## Context

The first portal shipped with its own figure.css, written for the docs
pages and tuned by hand over the spring.

When present was built it took that file and changed two selectors for the
review layout — the caption margin and the legend gap.

The March skin work then changed the portal's file again, and by June the
two files differed in eleven places, so a figure drawn for one surface
rendered differently on the other.

We tried twice to keep them aligned by review, and each time they had
drifted again within a month.

## Decision

We have decided that the kit's figure.css should probably be carried byte
for byte by every product that carries the kit.

It seems best that a product sheet which differs by even one byte fails
the drift check, although a project could argue for an exception.

Products may add figure CSS of their own, but only in a separate sheet
that is loaded after the kit sheet, which we think keeps the base intact.

## Consequences

Every product renders a figure the same way. Figure work happens once, in
the kit. The drift check keeps the sheets equal from now on.

## Architecture impact

None.
